technique: Jump or step to the top chin-over-bar position, then lower for 3–5+ seconds to a full hang.
Reset at the top each rep; do not bounce out of the bottom.
setup: Box or jump access to the top; choose pronated, neutral, or chin-up grip.
breathing: Inhale or brace through the slow descent; avoid panic breath-holds.
commonMistakes: Dropping the last third of the ROM
safety: High eccentric fatigue — low volume; recover between sessions.

evidenceRefs.label: NSCA Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning (technique/safety norms)
de Leva 1996 — adjusted segmental mass proportions (Zatsiorsky–Seluyanov)
Dickie et al. 2017 — EMG across pronated/supinated/neutral/rope pull-up grips

bodyweightFraction.rationale: Hands stay on the bar; estimate ≈1 − 2×(forearm+hand) using de Leva male proportions (2×1.62% + 2×0.61% ≈ 4.5% BM), so ~0.95–0.97 of body mass is moved. Not a force-plate measurement.
